# Prime Depot Global Enterprises LLC

> Direct importer and supplier of premium rigid cellular PVC trim boards and sheets in Massachusetts. Published prices, no minimum order, in stock in Hyde Park, MA and delivered to the job site or lumber yard across Massachusetts. Tagline: "We sell. You build. We deliver."

Prime Depot sells to contractors, general builders, exterior remodelers, siding specialists, lumber yards and homeowners. Orders start from a cut list sent by phone or through the quote form, and are confirmed the same business day.

## Material

- 30 to 50 year service life
- 100% waterproof: does not swell, rot or grow mold
- Termite proof and UV-stabilized
- Ships white and never needs paint; fully paintable in any color
- Cuts and works like wood with standard tools, no special tools needed

## FAQ

- **Do you deliver to my job site?** Yes, across Massachusetts, straight to the job site or lumber yard.
- **Is there a minimum order?** No. Buy exactly what the job needs at direct importer pricing.
- **How do I order?** Send a cut list by phone or through the quote form. Stock and delivery are confirmed right away.
- **Are the prices on the site real?** Yes. The published price is the price paid; large projects can ask for volume pricing.
- **Will it hold up to Massachusetts moisture and snow?** Yes. It is 100% waterproof, will not swell or rot, is termite proof and UV-stabilized.
